sloka: दिदृक्षमाणौ वैदेहीम् तत् वनम् तौ विचिक्यतुः ।तत्र तत्र अवतिष्ठन्तौ सीता हरण दुःखितौ ॥३-६९-७॥
transliteration: didṛkṣamāṇau vaidehīm tat vanam tau vicikyatuḥ ।tatra tatra avatiṣṭhantau sītā haraṇa duḥkhitau ॥3-69-7॥

translations.english: Tormented due to abduction of Sita, the two princes anxious to see her searched all over the dense forest stopping here and there on the way. The thick forest looked like a conglomeration of big clouds. It was filled with different kinds of birds, snakes and animals.
translations.hindi: उन दोनों की इस प्रकार की बातचीत सुन, राक्षस क्रुद्ध दो अपना भयङ्कर मुँह फेला, उन दोनों को खाने के लिए तैयार हुआ
